{{Top|leg}}
'''Benzodi''' was a tranquilizer drug that was developed during the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] following the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. It was milder than [[somatoll]], and could be used on [[Species/Legends|species]] that were [[Allergy/Legends|allergic]] to other forms of tranquilizers.<ref name="abyss">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref>
